facts.fact: 雨停后 Cándido 拿着玫瑰（她讨厌玫瑰、偏爱百合）上门逼婚，Perla 谁也不想理。
facts.anchor: Cándido arrived after the rain had ceased. He came with a bouquet under his arm and a wan smile.

facts.fact: Perla 对两个求婚者都不满意：她要的不是甜言蜜语也不是偷情，心里那份渴望是一处溃烂的伤口。
facts.anchor: The yearning in her heart was a putrefied wound.

facts.fact: 全章动机核心：她想灼灼燃烧，一挥抹掉此生唯一爱过、却被妹妹夺走的男人 Norberto Bustillo 的记忆。
facts.anchor: To erase in one violent stroke the memory of the one man she’d ever loved and whom her sister had taken from her: Norberto Bustillo.

facts.fact: Cándido 求婚如办案：一个月内宣布订婚、年底前完婚；还报出「牙齿头发健康都在」的实用条件。
facts.anchor: “I wanted to have a serious talk with you. You and I have avoided the question of marriage, but it’s about time we settled it.

facts.fact: Perla 嘴上说「我会考虑」，随即迅速而坚定地偏头以示轻蔑——婚约当面告吹。
facts.anchor: Then she turned her head away with quick and firm disdain.

facts.fact: Perla 的产权观：Inés 归她驱使圈养，如同兽笼里的美洲豹或狼；她本可把 Inés 交给 Salvador 打发走，却留下来折辱。
facts.anchor: Yet she was still her niece. Hers to command and to keep, the same way a wild animal, a jaguar or a wolf, might be kept in a menagerie.

facts.fact: 闪回（现在时）：Veracruz 求偶季，Norberto 登场，吻手「更像一次呼吸」并直视她的眼睛——她此生唯一的爱。
facts.anchor: “Not too short, I hope, or we’ll be cruelly deprived of the pleasure of your company,” Norberto says, and he takes Perla’s hand and kisses it, though it is more a breath than a kiss, a sigh.

facts.fact: 钢琴晚会上 Encarnación 一开嗓掌声如雷，Perla 疑心听众只为妹妹一人鼓掌。
facts.anchor: When the applause comes, it is thunderous.

facts.fact: 反转：Norberto 求娶的是妹妹 Encarnación（父亲为合并公司促成），Perla 连坏消息都是第三个知道的。
facts.anchor: “Norberto sent a telegram to your father and then came to speak to me. He has decided to ask for Encarnación’s hand in marriage.”

facts.fact: Encarnación 拒绝替嫁：她爱的是有妇之夫 Rómulo，「我就是不愿意」——Inclán 家第一个说不的女儿。
facts.anchor: Now Father expects me to do the same, to marry someone I do not love, but I won’t.

facts.fact: 周五清晨 Encarnación 与 Rómulo 私奔，只留两封短信：别找她，原谅她。
facts.anchor: The letters are brief and contain the same message: Encarnación has run away with Rómulo. Do not look for her. Forgive her.

facts.fact: 父亲 storm 进门宣布：救命的公司合并泡汤、Norberto 逃往 Xalapa、全家彻底破产——Perla 后半生的贫穷由此定账。
facts.anchor: We’ve lost everything. I’ve borrowed a great deal of money; my one chance of survival was to merge my company with Bustillo’s.
